regions.name: Dranik Hollows
regions.summary: Collapsed tunnels, ravines, and hidden enclaves where Dranik survivors cling to life under Muramite patrols.

regions.name: Dranik Scar
regions.summary: A vast, open wound in Kuua’s surface where Discord energy pours into the world, spawning riftspawn and warping reality.

regions.name: Bloodfields
regions.summary: Endless warfields where Muramite legions clash with resistance forces and Discord-forged beasts roam among the dead.

regions.name: Riftseekers’ Sanctum
regions.summary: Hidden sanctums and arcane anchors where Riftseekers attempt to contain Kuua’s planar and temporal damage.
themes: negotiation between mortals and planar entities

regions.name: Muramite Citadel Complex
regions.summary: The interconnected citadels of Qvic, Inktu’Ta, Txevu, and Tacvi, forming the heart of Muramite power on Kuua.
